title: Achimota School Administration Block
geometryBasis: The standing Achimota School Administration Block in Accra, including its clock tower, arched main frontage and attached ranges.
sectionBasis: The 31-point probable administration building sits by Guggisberg Street inside the named campus. The clear photograph places the clock tower to the left of the ceremonial entrance and shows arched wings. Original terrain was frozen before construction.
limitations: The named school campus is mapped. The actual Administration Block footprint is inferred from the central projection, side ranges and nearby Guggisberg Street connection. Exact component assignment and approach grade are approximate.
The Qualla photograph establishes the clock, wide entrance arch, window rhythm, wings and flared metal tower roof. The upper levels, rear ranges and concealed roof junctions are estimated.
The original terrain is retained. The outer wings use stepped floor levels, and the front stairs follow the approximate local grade.
